svg.title: How this site gets from a git push to your browser
svg.desc: A deployment diagram. On my MacBook, I write plain HTML and CSS in VS Code, then git push. Self hosted at home as Docker containers, GitLab takes the commit, Komodo sees the webhook and redeploys, nginx serves the files, and newt dials out. The connection crosses the internet through an encrypted outbound tunnel. On a VPS, Pangolin holds the public address and terminates TLS, then serves your browser over HTTPS. No inbound ports are forwarded at home.
svg.text: From a git push to your browser

g.text: This page, however you got here.
